what.name: Study
what.value_plain: Tom spike fade: a rushed push to a new day extreme, faded back to where it started, BTCUSDT or ETHUSDT: BTCUSDT, 5m candles, UTC day as the session: when the last 6 candles span at least 4 x ATR14 and the candle makes a new high (low) of the day, wait up to 3 candles for a close beyond the spike candle's far side; enter against the push at the next candle open, stop at the spike extreme (at least 0.4 % away), target where the push started, out at the end of the UTC day; fees 0.02 % limit / 0.05 % market, plus 0.02 % slippage on market and stop fills; 2022-04-01 to 2024-06-30, development window only.
what.label: OURS

how: export_trades.py replays every filled trade of the desk run from its own ref (same bars, same code, same fees) and lists entry, stop, target and exit as percent from the fill, signed in the trade's favour; net R is after fees.
window: DEV only, 2022-04-01 to 2024-06-30 (VALIDATION and HOLDOUT never offered)
why: the whole 95 % range of the average -0.269 to -0.176 R is below zero: it loses money after fees
